notes.title: Neon Parasite is now out!
notes.notes: This is the biggest thing I've ever made and I'm super excited for everyone to be able to experience it! For anyone who has been following the development on twitter or who I've met at the various festivals I've exhibited the game at, thankyou for taking an interest in this (much larger than anticipated) project of mine!
